01 · A WIDER SERVICE MIX

Cowlendar

Test groups, rentals and payment options with the same feature set and revenue-based pricing.

Why it belongs on the shortlist

One Shopify booking workflow for appointments, group sessions and multi-day rentals. Appointments, classes, bundles and rentals in one app, with all features available from the free plan.

What to check before choosing

All features are available from the free plan. Paid pricing follows booking revenue; usage allowances and optional messaging charges still apply. See the pricing page for full details.

02 · LOW-COST APPOINTMENT TEAMS

Apntly

Compare unlimited services/staff on the paid offering and the Pro features you actually need.

Why it belongs on the shortlist

A low entry price for service appointments and team scheduling. A solo service or a team prioritizing a low fixed subscription cost.

What to check before choosing

Group appointments, custom questions, calendar integrations and deposits are listed on Pro. Check the exact workflow before choosing Starter.

03 · MULTIPLE LOCATIONS

BookX

Useful to investigate when explicit location and staff limits help plan expansion.

Why it belongs on the shortlist

Explicit tiers for locations and staff, with rental and seasonal-pricing options. Businesses comparing location counts, team capacity and seasonal pricing.

What to check before choosing

The listing separates basic Google Calendar integration from two-way sync on Business. Do not assume the cheaper plan includes the same synchronization behavior.

04 · FREE BOOKING VOLUME

Appointo

Compare the free allowance and the higher tier needed for advanced staff/customer workflows.

Why it belongs on the shortlist

A broad free plan with feature-based upgrades and customer-facing portals. Stores that need ongoing free bookings or want customer self-service and advanced scheduling options.

What to check before choosing

The listing discloses text/WhatsApp usage charges and a 2% charge for subscriptions/bundles on paid tiers. Include those costs in a like-for-like comparison.

A SWITCH WITHOUT SURPRISES

Take your real workflow into the trial.

  1. Write the reason for leaving. Identify the failed requirement, its business impact and the acceptance test for the replacement.
  2. Price an actual month. Include staff, resources, booking revenue, messages and any package-related charges.
  3. Test the awkward case. Recreate a calendar conflict, an overlapping rental or the final group seat, then cancel and inspect the payment outcome.
  4. Reconcile before switching. Confirm future reservations, customer notices and outstanding balances with the destination vendor. Keep the old records until the transition is checked.
